    Class ScrollZoomHandler

    Named scrollZoom handler. Phase 1: adapts the existing MouseWheel DOM primitive, re-emitting its 'mousewheel' event. When disabled, re-emission is suppressed (MouseWheel itself has no enable flag, so the handler gates at the boundary).

    Example

    Runnable example association: box-select, feature-rotate-scale, feature-selection.
